Problem in KiCad footprints that behave as locked when they are not. by: William Harter Jul 18,2026 1299 Views 0 Comments Posted in PCB Design & Layout PCB layout KiCAD Locked Will Not Unlock Footprint Summary： In KiCad, some footprints may behave to be locked even when they are not Problem In KiCad, some footprints behave as locked even when they are not. For example, when moving a grouped set of footprints on a PCB, most of the footprints move as expected, but one or two may remain in place.
